role: One of the ender dragon's seven independently placed hit boxes (head, body, three tails, two wings): a server-side Entity subclass that forwards damage to the owning dragon's attackEntityFromPart.

members.name: entityDragonObj
members.note: the parts live inside the owner's struct dragon_state (part[7]); the back link is implicit in the embedding

members.name: field_146032_b
members.note: the part name strings (head, body, tail, wing) are not stored; native parts are identified by index in dragon_state.part; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: EntityDragonPart
members.note: dragon_init takes the seven part constructors' Det draws (entity id, Random, UUID) in array order; the constructor sizes come from dragon_setup

members.name: readEntityFromNBT
members.note: empty in Java; the parts are never saved, only the owning dragon is

members.name: canBeCollidedWith
members.note: true; the parts are the collidable others that projectiles and explosions hit

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: forwards to attackEntityFromPart; the explosion path uses the explosion's source with no exploder, the dev hurt op (csrc/engine/dev.c, the hurt command) the player's source

members.name: isEntityEqual
members.note: n/a: its one caller is EntityFireball.onUpdate's collision loop; no fireball exists in the End (ghasts and blazes are the Nether's, the dragon shoots none in 1.7.10, a fire charge only leaves a dispenser: redstone = off)

notes: The parts exist only as dragon_state.part[7] inside the owning dragon (csrc/engine/dragon.h); their boxes are built by csrc/engine/serverreplay.c:sr_part_box and reached from projectile hits (sr_end_query_other, sr_end_other_hit) and explosions (sr_end_blast_query). end-dragon-s1's bow hit on the head exercises the head part; test_dragon.c drives dragon_attack_part per part. Not verified: whether any vanilla server-side code reads field_146032_b beyond the constructor. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): part names are indices natively. Formerly listed as missing: The part name strings carried by field_146032_b are not stored natively; parts are identified by their index in dragon_state.part. Since lane/endbot: the client pick lists the seven parts of the client copy right after the dragon (pickobj_client_candidates), the client attack runs attackEntityFromPart's three draws on the copy and wears the held sword or tool (pickobj_client_attack), and the server's C02 on a part is processUseEntity plus attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem with the part as target (no crit, no enchantment, hitEntity on the dragon, no damageDealt stat).
